propositions: Eight CI lanes lack per-test hang guards despite external/live-service tests being susceptible to deadlock, leaving hung tests hidden without traceback or culprit identification.

Historical runtime data shows wide variance across lanes (single test at 24-29s to 63 tests at 2384-2635s), requiring per-lane timeout budgets calibrated from observed mean durations rather than a blanket timeout.

Detection rule for pytest invocations must distinguish actual pytest commands from arguments in pip install lines and YAML comments, matching four command forms: bare pytest, pytest -m, python -m pytest, and path-prefixed python -m pytest.

Each of eight lanes requires both --timeout and --timeout-method=thread flags added, with per-lane budgets ranging 300–3600 seconds derived from operator decision rule and live-service variance allowance.

Anti-regression test must exhaustively sweep all .github/workflows files to verify every pytest-invoking step carries both timeout flags, with liveness proof that all four command forms are detected and covered.
